source: Statistics South Africa, General Household Survey 2024 v1; DataFirst, CC-BY
income_note: Codebook p106 describes restricted measurement above R20000 although released values exceed it. Preserve raw data and cap model income at R20000 consistently at training/inference; no outlier rows removed.
target_definition: GHS 2024 FSD8: household ran out of food because of insufficient money/resources during the last 12 months (1=Yes, 2=No).
scope: National cross-sectional survey. Target is reported past food shortage, not future hunger or a validated food-insecurity severity scale. NGO validation is outstanding.
